fn.en: Talk about your family and say whose it is.
fn.ru: Рассказывать о семье и говорить, чьё это.
fn.kk: Отбасың туралы айту және кімдікі екенін айту.

can.en: I can talk about my family and say whose it is.
can.ru: Я могу рассказать о семье и сказать, чьё это.
can.kk: Отбасым туралы айтып, кімдікі екенін айта аламын.

tip.en: Person + ’s = whose: Dana’s brother. my/your/his/her never change.
tip.ru: Человек + ’s = чей: Dana’s brother. my/your/his/her не меняются.
tip.kk: Адам + ’s = кімнің: Dana’s brother. my/your/his/her өзгермейді.

q.en: you have a husband or a wife

lines: This is [my|me|mine] family. [My|Me|Mine] father is a taxi driver.
I have one sister. [Her|His|She] name is Aliya and she is nineteen.
Aliya is married. [Her|His|Their] husband is from Turkey.
[Their|Our|His] son is two. He is [Aliya’s|Aliya|of Aliya] first child.
My grandparents are eighty. [Their|Them|They] house is in Almaty.

tts: Have you got any brothers and sisters? Yes, I’ve got two sisters. What are their names? Agneta and Inga. Agneta is twenty-six and Inga’s twenty-one. What are their jobs? Well, Agneta’s got a job in a bank and Inga’s a student. Are they married? Inga isn’t married, but Agneta is. Her husband’s an engineer.

acts.title: The group chat
text: My mother is Gulnara. She is forty-eight.
My father is Bekzat. He is fifty-two.
I have one brother. His name is Timur and he is married.
Timur’s wife is Dana. Their daughter is four. 👧

items.sit: You show a photo of your mother to a colleague.
Your friend asks about Marat. Marat has one sister, Aliya.
o: Aliya is the sister of Marat.

items.sit: Someone asks about Dana. Dana has a husband, Timur.
items.why: her = Dana’s. The possessive follows the owner, not the thing.

items.sit: You talk about your grandparents’ home.
Someone asks: “Are you married?” You are not.
You want to know how big your new colleague’s family is.

lines.s: And the man next to her?
That’s my father. ___ name is Bekzat.
No, she’s my brother’s daughter. ___ name is Aruzhan.
They live with us. ___ room is upstairs.

write.q: Write 5 sentences about your family. Use my, his, her, their and one ’s.
write.model: This is my family. My mother is a teacher and my father is an engineer. I have one brother. His name is Timur and he is married. Timur’s wife is Dana and their son is three.

speak.q: Introduce three people in your family out loud. Say who they are and one fact about each.
speak.model: This is my mother. Her name is Gulnara and she is fifty. This is my brother Timur. He is married. And this is Timur’s daughter — their daughter is four.
